import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { SKILL_TYPE_BATTLE, SKILL_TYPE_MYSTIC, SKILL_TYPE_PASSIVE } from '@src/constants';
import { DEFAULT_PAGE, EMPTY_STRING, FIRST_ARG_INDEX, MIN_PAGE } from '@src/constants/common';
import App from '@src/response-apps/skillBook/mySkillBooks/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { parsePageNumber } from '@src/utils/commandParser';
import { createQuoteMarkdown, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { formatSkillBookListItem } from '@src/utils/skillBookHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
// 常量定义
const EMPTY_TOTAL = 0; // 空总数量

// 功法槽位类型列表
const SKILL_SLOTS = [SKILL_TYPE_BATTLE, SKILL_TYPE_MYSTIC, SKILL_TYPE_PASSIVE] as const;

const response = onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  // uid 已由中间件验证并设置
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  // 解析命令参数（移除命令前缀）
  const messageText = (e.MessageText || EMPTY_STRING).replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?我的功法\s*/, EMPTY_STRING).trim();
  const args = messageText ? messageText.split(/\s+/) : [];

  // 解析页码
  const parseResult = parsePageNumber(args, FIRST_ARG_INDEX, DEFAULT_PAGE);
  const page = parseResult.success ? parseResult.value! : DEFAULT_PAGE;

  // 调用数据层
  const result = await App({ bid, uid, page: Math.max(MIN_PAGE, page - 1) });

  if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '我的功法',
        header: [{ label: '返回', command: '/属性面板' }],
        content: md,
        footer: [
          { label: '一键学习', command: '/一键学习功法' },
          { label: '功法书', command: '/储物袋 功法' }
        ]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  const { inUseBooks, items, total, totalPages, currentPage, proficiencyPoints } = result.data;

  // 构建当前装备功法槽位显示
  const slotContent = Format.createMarkdown();

  slotContent.addText(`持有熟练点：${proficiencyPoints}`);
  slotContent.addNewline();
  slotContent.addNewline();

  SKILL_SLOTS.forEach(slotType => {
    const equipped = inUseBooks.find(book => book.skillType === slotType);

    if (equipped) {
      const actionMd = Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${slotType}：${equipped.slotText} `);

      actionMd.addButton('选择', { data: `/切换${slotType}` });
      actionMd.addText(' ');
      actionMd.addButton('查看', { data: `/查看功法 ${equipped.id}` });
      actionMd.addText(' ');
      actionMd.addButton('换下', { data: `/换下${slotType}` });
      slotContent.addBlockquote(actionMd);
    } else {
      slotContent.addBlockquote(
        Format.createMarkdown()
          .addText(`${slotType}：空 `)
          .addButton('选择', { data: `/切换${slotType}` })
      );
    }
  });

  // 首页展示使用槽位，功法列表从第二页开始。
  if (page === MIN_PAGE) {
    if (total === EMPTY_TOTAL) {
      slotContent.addText('💡暂无已学习的功法').addNewline();
    }
    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '我的功法',
        header: [{ label: '返回', command: '/属性面板' }],
        content: slotContent,
        footer: [
          ...(total > EMPTY_TOTAL ? [{ label: '功法列表', command: '/我的功法 2' }] : []),
          ...(result.data.canUseFifthLayerFeature ? [{ label: '战斗模板', command: '/战斗模板' }] : []),
          { label: '一键学习', command: '/一键学习功法' },
          { label: '功法书', command: '/储物袋 功法' },
          { label: '隐藏列表', command: '/我的隐藏功法' }
        ],
        ...(total > EMPTY_TOTAL ? { nav: { current: MIN_PAGE, total: totalPages + 1, command: '/我的功法 {page}' } } : {})
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  // 如果没有功法
  if (total === EMPTY_TOTAL) {
    slotContent.addText('💡暂无已学习的功法');
    slotContent.addNewline();

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '我的功法',
        header: [{ label: '返回', command: '/属性面板' }],
        content: slotContent,
        footer: [
          { label: '一键学习', command: '/一键学习功法' },
          { label: '功法书', command: '/储物袋 功法' }
        ]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  // 如果页码超出范围
  if (items.length === EMPTY_TOTAL && total > EMPTY_TOTAL) {
    slotContent.addText('❌ 页码超出范围');
    slotContent.addNewline();
    slotContent.addText(`总功法数: ${total}，请选择 2-${totalPages + 1} 之间的页码`);

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '我的功法',
        header: [{ label: '返回', command: '/属性面板' }],
        content: slotContent,
        nav: { current: MIN_PAGE + 1, total: totalPages + 1, count: total, command: '/我的功法 {page}' },
        footer: [
          { label: '一键学习', command: '/一键学习功法' },
          { label: '功法书', command: '/储物袋 功法' }
        ]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  // 构建功法列表
  const skillBookItems = items.map(skillBook => ({
    id: skillBook.id,
    text: formatSkillBookListItem(skillBook, skillBook.id),
    attrText: skillBook.attributeSummary
  }));

  const listContent = Format.createMarkdown();

  listContent.addText('已学功法').addNewline();

  skillBookItems.forEach(item => {
    const lines = [item.text];

    if (item.attrText) {
      lines.push(item.attrText);
    }
    listContent.addBlockquote(
      createQuoteMarkdown(lines, [
        { label: '查看', command: `/查看功法 ${item.id}` },
        { label: '连续升级', command: `/升级功法 ${item.id} 选择` }
      ])
    );
  });

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '我的功法',
      header: [{ label: '返回', command: '/我的功法' }],
      content: listContent,
      footer: [
        ...(result.data.canUseFifthLayerFeature ? [{ label: '战斗模板', command: '/战斗模板' }] : []),
        { label: '一键学习', command: '/一键学习功法' },
        { label: '一键分解预览', command: '/一键分解功法' },
        { label: '隐藏列表', command: '/我的隐藏功法' }
      ],
      nav: { current: currentPage + 1, total: totalPages + 1, count: total, command: '/我的功法 {page}' }
    })
  );
});

export default response;
